description_en: Queries the settings of Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) authentication on a bastion host
description_zh: 获取堡垒机实例LDAP认证的配置
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-instance-ldap-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceLDAPAuthServer

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

Account.description_en: The account of the LDAP server

EmailMapping.description_en: The field that is used to indicate the email address of a user on the LDAP server
EmailMapping.description_zh: 用户邮箱对应的服务器的属性名

Filter.description_en: The condition that is used to filter users

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether passwords are required. Valid values:

true: required

false: not required
HasPassword.description_zh:
是否设置密码。取值：

true：设置密码
false：未设置密码

IsSSL.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL is supported. Valid values:

true: supported

false: not supported
IsSSL.description_zh:
是否支持SSL。取值：

true：支持
false：不支持

LoginNameMapping.description_en: The field that is used to indicate the logon name of a user on the LDAP server
LoginNameMapping.description_zh: 用户登录名对应服务器属性名

MobileMapping.description_en: The field that is used to indicate the mobile phone number of a user on the LDAP server
MobileMapping.description_zh: 用户手机号对应的服务器的属性名

NameMapping.description_en: The field that is used to indicate the name of a user on the LDAP server
NameMapping.description_zh: 用户名称对应的服务器的属性名

Port.description_en: The port that is used to access the LDAP server

Server.description_en: The address of the LDAP server

StandbyServer.description_en: The address of the secondary LDAP server

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
